Unblock classic-laddie's converge loop: the system build fails on hyprland because the pinned nixpkgs (nixos-unstable 20260804.e72e4f2) carries glaze 8.0.0 without the companion hyprland fix. Carry the upstream fix in an overlay until the channel catches up.

## Diagnosis, already established — verify, don't re-derive

- cosmo-rebuild has failed since 07:04 (journalctl -u cosmo-rebuild): leaf error "could not find git for clone of glaze" under hyprland, cascading through xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland to the toplevel.
- Upstream: nixpkgs issue 549246 (closed) — glaze 7.9.1 -> 8.0.0 broke hyprland's find_package(glaze), which falls back to a sandbox-impossible network FetchContent. Fixed on master by commit e0832b87 ("hyprland: fix build by relaxing glaze dependency", 2026-08-04). nixos-unstable's tip is still e72e4f2, so the fix has not reached the channel; a lock revert would be undone by tonight's auto-merged daily bump.

## What to build

Read commit e0832b87's actual diff first (gh api repos/NixOS/nixpkgs/commits/e0832b87). Replicate its change minimally as a nixpkgs overlay in cosmo, scoped to where hyprland is used. Requirements:

- The overlay reproduces the upstream fix's effect — prefer replicating its exact mechanism (patch, cmake flag, or dependency relaxation) over inventing an alternative like pinning glaze back.
- **It must retire safely.** Precedent: a temporary overlay once outlived its purpose and broke the build for six hours when the pin caught up (the catppuccin incident, cosmo #636). Prefer a change that is idempotent when the channel already carries the fix; if idempotence is impossible, guard it by inspecting the package it patches (version or an attribute the fix introduces), never by date. Comment the retirement condition tersely: when nixos-unstable advances past e0832b87, this overlay is deletable — and say how a reader verifies that.
- Follow cosmo's existing overlay conventions — find how overlays are currently wired (the catppuccin one's history is a reference) and match.

## Prove it

Build the previously failing path locally before opening the PR:
    nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --no-link
This is the exact invocation the converge unit runs. It must succeed. This takes a while — commit and push your branch BEFORE starting it, then open the PR after it passes. If it is still building as you approach limits, push, open the PR marked with what remains unverified, and say so plainly.

## Repo conventions

cosmo is GitHub-canonical: normal PR flow (branch, push, open PR). CI only dry-runs eval, so your local toplevel build is the real verification — say in the PR body that it was run and passed. Terse comments. No Co-Authored-By trailers naming Claude or Anthropic; no mention of AI in the commit or PR body.

## Do not park

Never end the run without having pushed and opened the PR.

# TEMPORARY build fix for hyprland.
#
# The locked nixpkgs (nixos-unstable e72e4f2) bumped glaze 7.9.1 -> 8.0.0
# without the companion hyprland fix, so hyprland's
# `find_package(glaze 7...<8)` misses and CMake falls back to a network
# FetchContent that cannot work in the sandbox ("could not find git for clone
# of glaze", nixpkgs issue #549246). Upstream fixed this on master in commit
# e0832b87 ("hyprland: fix build by relaxing glaze dependency") by relaxing
# the version range in postPatch; this overlay replicates that exact change.
#
# REMOVAL CONDITION: delete this overlay once the locked nixpkgs contains
# e0832b87. Verify with
#   git -C <nixpkgs> merge-base --is-ancestor e0832b87 <locked rev>
# or simply: nixpkgs' hyprland postPatch already mentions glaze. The guard
# below keeps nixpkgs' own package untouched in that case, so a stale overlay
# cannot re-break the build — but remove the dead code anyway.
final: prev:
{
  hyprland =
    # No-op once nixpkgs' own postPatch handles glaze (see REMOVAL CONDITION).
    if prev.lib.hasInfix "glaze" (prev.hyprland.postPatch or "") then
      prev.hyprland
    else
      prev.hyprland.overrideAttrs (old: {
        postPatch = ''
          # Relax glaze dependency (nixpkgs e0832b87)
          substituteInPlace CMakeLists.txt start/CMakeLists.txt hyprpm/CMakeLists.txt \
            --replace-fail "glaze 7...<8" "glaze"
        '' + (old.postPatch or "");
      });
}
